flags_note: 0x01 is a drive-ready gate, NOT media-gated (command answers with no disc, proven on hardware)
dispatch: cdb[4] (subfn) selects the reply. 04 (Raw Read) forces host-cert approve via set_agid_state(0/1,6) then GOOD; 09 (DumpAll) reads 64 bytes at cdb[5..9]. Other subfns write their 16-byte payload slot (cleared, written via 0xa2074, committed via 0x98180). A non-matching mode/knock tail-calls the OEM handler.
de_note: downgrade-enable: write 0xDE unconditionally so every freemkv image flashes over any prior version; not covered by the CMAC integrity regions
hardware_proven: LG BU40N 1.00, /dev/sg0: 3C 0E C0 DE 01 -> 'freemkv <version>'; 09 DumpAll reads live SRAM; DE gates downgrade. 0.6.0's inline-producer 03 wedged the controller (dead SATA target, reboot to recover); 0.6.1 Raw Read is approve-only. Disc-in VID test pending.
note: cleanroom manifest — freemkv-authored bytes + integrity hashes only, no OEM code. The Rust KAT (mt1959_kat_tests.rs) is the enforced, byte-exact source of truth; this file is descriptive and intentionally omits drift-prone goldens (output hash / CMAC deltas) so it cannot go stale against the enforced test.
